slides.title: Performance Profiling Tools
slides.prompt: Python provides `timeit` for micro-benchmarking code snippets, `cProfile` for deterministic macro-level function call profiling, and `line_profiler` for line-by-line execution time analysis.
slides.codeSnippet:
import timeit
import cProfile

# Micro-benchmark execution time
execution_time = timeit.timeit('[x**2 for x in range(1000)]', number=10000)

# Function call profile
def heavy_computation():

      return sum(i * i for i in range(100000))

cProfile.run('heavy_computation()')
